title: Cothú Gan Choinne an tSeanóra
intro: I gceantair naofa Theach Allah, bhí taithí ag seirbhíseach Dé aosta ar rúndiamhair dhomhain a sháraigh gach ionchas. Chonaic an duine dílis seo, a raibh blianta na tuismitheoireachta nádúrtha aige i bhfad tharainn, rud éigin neamhghnách a léirigh trócaire gan teorainn an Diaga. Tá an puzal suite i nochtadh an nóiméid dearmadta seo ó shaol na bhfáithe.
clues: Bhí aithne ar mo mhuintir mar Iosrael, sliocht patriarch mhóir fadó.
Chaith mé mo oícheanta ag paidir, ag umhlú os comhair mo Thiarna sa teampall.
Bronnadh mac orm i mo sheanaois, bronntanas nár stop mé riamh ag glóiriú Allah as.
Bhain mo thriail le cothú a aimsiú a tháinig chun cinn d'anam óg faoi mo chúram.
Ba fáidh mé darbh ainm Zakariyya, a raibh de chúram orm aire a thabhairt do Maryam i Bayt al-Maqdis.
Tá an freagra sa véarsa inar ghlac Allah le Muiream agus inar sholáthair sé cothú di.

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
